_provenance: eBay FeeTypeEnum (Sell Finances API) mapped to the seven HobbyIQ fee fields. The mapping is the ruling; the enum is eBay's.
_rule: An eBay fee type that matches no bucket lands in otherFees AND has its name reported (unknownFeeTypes) — on SIGHTING, so a 0.00 or non-numeric amount is still named. Nothing is ever dropped, and nothing is ever invented.
_nullVsZero: D34 R2 (2026-09-01). Sighting is PER BUCKET, not global. A bucket no line touched stays NULL (unknown). A bucket touched by a line is a NUMBER — including a line eBay valued at 0.00, because a stated zero is a fact. R1 carried one global sawAnyFee flag and had this exactly backwards in both directions: one fee line fabricated zeros into all five buckets, while an explicit 0.00 line was discarded by a `v === 0` early-out and came back null. It reported zero when it did not know, and unknown when it had been told zero.
_shipping: D34 R2. actualShippingCost is NEVER fabricated. No SHIPPING_LABEL means the field stays NULL and the diagnostic shippingAbsentFromEbay carries the fact that the fetch completed without one. R1 wrote a 0 there so the row could pass feesAxisSatisfied; feesAxisSatisfied now reads the fact instead, so the row closes without an invented measurement and a label eBay posts later can still land.
_netPayout: D34 R2. Attribution is PER SALE TRANSACTION: each SALE's own totalFeeAmount is subtracted from its own amount, and REFUND amounts are netted out. R1 subtracted one global fee sum from one global gross, which on a mixed-basis multi-SALE order took one line item's fees off two line items' gross (186.75 instead of 173.50) while reporting the basis 'amount_minus_total_fees'. A compound derivation now reports 'mixed_per_line_item'.

finalValueFee.note: The fixed per-order component IS part of the final value fee. Before D34 it fell to otherFees, splitting one real-world fee across two columns.

paymentProcessingFee.note: Under managed payments eBay generally folds processing into the final value fee and sends no separate line. Absent line => the field stays null (unknown), never a fabricated 0.

promotedListingFee.note: Promoted Listings Standard. Can also arrive as a NON_SALE_CHARGE transaction with top-level fees[] when billed off-payout, which is why top-level fees[] is still read.

adFee.note: Advanced / display advertising, distinct from Promoted Standard.

otherFees.note: The honest catch-all. Reported by name so the taxonomy grows deliberately.

netPayout.source: SALE transaction: amount - totalFeeAmount when totalFeeAmount is present, else amount
netPayout.note: eBay's amount on a SALE is GROSS. Treating it as net understates fees by the whole fee total.

actualShipping.source: SHIPPING_LABEL transaction amount (negative; absolute value taken)
